rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACder
Exhibition name: Red Masterpiece
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, 1974).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) as 'Red Masterpiece'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1978 as 'Red Masterpiece'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Strong, old rose fragrance. 30 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Heat tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
